name: Seos Social Icons
author: seosbg

sections.description:
Seos Social Icons adds beautiful, fast social media and contact icons anywhere on your WordPress site. Made by SEOS Themes – the authors of free WordPress themes downloaded more than 2 000 000 times.

Every icon is an inline SVG stored inside the plugin. Nothing is loaded from Google, Font Awesome or any other external server – better speed, better privacy (GDPR friendly) and no broken icons if a CDN goes down.

90+ icons

Facebook, X (Twitter), Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, Tumblr, VK, Telegram, WhatsApp, Viber, Messenger, Signal, Discord, Twitch, Kick, Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music, GitHub, Dribbble, Behance, Etsy, Amazon, PayPal, Patreon, Tripadvisor, Google Play, App Store, Steam, Email, Phone, SMS, Website, Map, RSS… and many more. Add the same network more than once (e.g. two phone numbers) and give every icon a custom title.

18 skins, 10 shapes, 17 hover effects

  • Skins: Brand colours, Brand outline, Brand icon only, Soft tint, Gradient, 3D button, Neon glow, Glass, Bold/retro, Dark, Light card, Mono outline, Minimal grey, White (for dark backgrounds), Two-tone split, Underline bar, Custom colours, Classic.
  • Shapes: circle, rounded square, square, squircle, hexagon, octagon, diamond, leaf, drop, shield.
  • Hover effects: lift, grow, shrink, tilt, spin, 3D flip, pulse, bounce, shake, slide swap, fill from bottom, glow, shine sweep, fade, invert, turn brand colour.
  • Entrance animations: fade, slide up, zoom, pop one by one.
  • Full control: icon size, spacing, logo size, corner radius, border width, opacity, animation speed, shadows, colours for icon / background / border / hover / labels / tooltips, quick colour sets, black & white until hover, labels (tooltip, text next to the icon, text under the icon), row / column / grid layouts, alignment.
  • Live preview in the settings page – see every change before you save.

Insert the icons everywhere

  • Floating side bar (left or right) – turns into a bottom bar on phones, with a hide/show button.
  • Before / after the content of posts, pages or any custom post type.
  • Navigation menus – automatically at the end of any classic menu.
  • Top bar with your own text (e.g. phone number).
  • Footer of every page.
  • Widget – every widget can have its own skin, shape and size.
  • Gutenberg block – also works in the Site Editor (block themes).
  • Shortcode [ssi] – in posts, pages, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, text widgets…
  • PHP <?php ssi_include(); ?> – in theme files.

Shortcode examples

[ssi] – icons with your saved settings
[ssi skin="neon" shape="hexagon" size="50"]
[ssi networks="facebook,instagram,youtube" labels="right" align="center"]
[ssi c_icon="#ffffff" c_bg="#111111" hover="glow" animation="pop"]

The full list of attributes and network keys is in Seos Social Icons → How to insert.

Upgrading from version 1.0 is safe

Your links, the [ssi] shortcode and the ssi_include() function keep working. After the update your icons look exactly the same as before (the “Classic” skin with the original images) until you choose a new skin. The old settings are also kept in sync, so you can even go back to 1.0 without losing anything.

More from SEOS

  • Free WordPress themes – responsive, fast, WooCommerce ready.
  • Premium theme bundle
  • Plugin page & support

Credits

Brand icons: Font Awesome Free (icons CC BY 4.0) and Simple Icons (CC0). All brand names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Seos Social Icons”.
  2. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  3. Open Seos Social Icons in the admin menu, add your links and choose a skin.

Via ZIP / FTP

  1. Upload the seos-social-icons folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
sections.faq:
Are the icons loaded from an external website?

No. All icons are inline SVG files inside the plugin. The plugin makes no external requests.

I used version 1.0. Will my icons break?

No. Your links are imported automatically and the icons look the same as before. [ssi] and ssi_include() still work.

How do I show the icons in my header with a block theme?

Open Appearance → Editor, edit the Header template part and add the “Seos Social Icons” block.

Can I use different styles on the same page?

Yes. Every shortcode, widget and block can have its own skin, shape, size and colours.

How do I add WhatsApp, Viber, phone or email links?

Use https://wa.me/359888123456, viber://chat?number=%2B359888123456, tel:+359888123456 or simply type an e-mail address – it is converted to a mailto: link automatically.

Where can I find themes that match?

Have a look at the free themes on seosthemes.com.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Completely rewritten.
  • 93 icons, all stored locally as inline SVG (no CDN, no external requests).
  • 18 skins, 10 shapes, 17 hover effects, 4 entrance animations, shadows.
  • Colour, size, spacing, radius, border, opacity and label options with live preview.
  • New placements: floating bar (with mobile bottom bar), before/after content, menus, top bar, footer.
  • New widget and Gutenberg block.
  • Shortcode attributes for per-instance styling. New ssi_get_icons() function.
  • Drag & drop ordering, custom titles, same network more than once.
  • Export / import of settings.
  • Bulgarian translation.
  • Full backward compatibility with 1.0: settings are migrated, [ssi] and ssi_include() keep working and the original look is kept (Classic skin).
  • Security: all settings sanitised and escaped, nonces and capability checks.

1.0

  • Initial release of plugin.
